_schema: Scenario overlays for the simulation engine (docs/011_Simulation.md). drift_shift is added to the bootstrapped daily return; vol_mult scales it around its mean; first_n_days limits the drift overlay to the opening stretch (0 = whole horizon). Rationale must cite the situation that motivates the scenario.

scenarios.label: Baseline — current dynamics persist
scenarios.rationale: Pure block-bootstrap of the last decade of WTI daily returns; no overlay.

scenarios.label: Hormuz closure hardens / conflict escalates
scenarios.rationale: Strait stays shut and strikes intensify; sustained supply-shock drift with crisis-level volatility (2026-07-13 re-closure, ~25% of seaborne trade).

scenarios.label: Qatar talks succeed — strait reopens
scenarios.rationale: Reopening repeats the early-July glut trade: sharp front-loaded selloff (analog: WTI slid toward $69 when Hormuz briefly reopened 2026-07-02), then normal dynamics.

scenarios.label: Closure persists with SPR near empty
scenarios.rationale: SPR at 1st percentile of 3y after -29.7M bbl in 4 weeks; a thinner buffer amplifies every subsequent disruption.
